_doc: Schema for a state income-tax table. One file per state, named <code>.json in lowercase. See docs/ADDING_A_STATE.md.
name: Full state name, for display.
source: Where the numbers came from. Required — a table with no citation cannot be verified.
rate: For kind='flat' only: the single marginal rate as a fraction.
estimate: true when the figures are an approximation rather than a published schedule. Surfaced to the user.

filing_status._doc: For kind='brackets'. Keys are mfj | single | hoh | mfs. Each holds 'brackets' ([upper, rate] pairs, null upper = unbounded) and 'standard_deduction'. A missing status falls back to 'single', then to the flat rate.

taxes_social_security: bool. false means SS benefits are fully exempt from state tax.
taxes_retirement_income: 'full' only, today. Partial exclusions (IL, PA, NY, MS...) are NOT yet modeled -- see the Limitations section of the README.
surtaxes: Optional list of {name, threshold, rate}: an extra rate on taxable income above the threshold.
property_tax_growth: Optional. Annual growth of assessed value, as a fraction. Overrides the national default when a state caps it.
insurance_inflation: Optional. Annual homeowners-premium growth, as a fraction.
index_brackets: bool. false when the state does not inflation-index its brackets -- bracket creep is then modeled correctly over a long projection.
local_tax_note: Optional string shown to the user where meaningful local income taxes exist (NYC, Philadelphia, Ohio municipalities).
